details.usageInstructions:
Step 1: Cooking the Dry Fruit Blend
Empty the dry fruit blend pack into a pan with 28 g (2 tbsp) sugar and 52 ml (4½ tbsp) water.
Bring the mixture to a boil and continue to cook for 2–3 minutes until the fruits soften.
Step 2: Preparing the Plum Cake Mix
Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
In a bowl, combine 250 g plum cake mix, 50 g (4 tbsp) melted unsalted butter, and 50 g (5 tbsp) vegetable oil.
Mix for 1–2 minutes until smooth.
Gently fold in the cooked dry fruits.
Pour the mixture into a greased pan and bake at 180 °C for 50–55 minutes.

details.description: Easy to use, custard powder is perfect for making smooth and creamy custards, thickening dessert sauces and fillings, improving the texture of puddings and pastries, and adding delicious richness to a variety of sweet treats.

details.storageInstructions:
Storage
Store in a cool, hygienic, and dry place; do not freeze/ refrigerate
How to Use
Mix: Stir 2 ½ tbsp (25 g) of custard powder with ½ cup (125 ml) of milk to form a paste and keep it aside.
Heat: Add 4 tbsp (50 g) sugar to the remaining milk (375 ml) and let the mixture come to a boil. Keeping the flame on low, now add the paste slowly to the boiling milk and stir continuously to avoid the mixture from burning. Continue to stir and cook on a low flame until the mixture thickens (2-3 mins)
Set: You can enjoy your custard either warm or chilled by adding fruits & other toppings of your choice!
For Set Custard
Use 4 tbsp (40 g) of custard powder per ½ ltr milk and follow the instructions as above to make moulded pudding.

This extract is 100% alcohol free, easily soluble and presented in convenient packaging for everyday use.
details.ingredients: Vanilla Extract & Propylene Glycol (INS 1520)
details.storageInstructions:
Storage
Store in full, tight containers in a cool, dry place protected from light, heat and air.

Naturally Brewed White Vinegar is a natural alternative to synthetic vinegar, produced through a traditional fermentation process. With its clean acidity, clear appearance, and balanced flavour, it is ideal for cooking, pickling, marinades, sauces, and everyday household use.
details.ingredients: Water, Cane Sugar Brewed to 5% Acidity.

details.description:
Drinking chocolate is a versatile treat that can be enjoyed
both hot and cold. Mix it with hot milk for a rich, comforting hot chocolate,
or blend it with cold milk and ice for a refreshing iced chocolate drink. It
also enhances coffee as a quick mocha or adds depth of flavour to milkshakes
and smoothies. Convenient to carry while traveling, ideal for festive
occasions, and perfect for DIY gift jars, drinking chocolate offers a delicious
way to enjoy chocolate in any season.
details.ingredients: Skimmed Milk Powder, Jaggery, Cocoa Powder

title: Hot Chocolate Mix With Vegan Marshmallows

details.description: Indulge in a truly unique and delectable experience with The Select Aisle's Hot Chocolate with vegan marshmallows. This first-of-its-kind treat is the perfect way to satisfy your sweet tooth and enjoy a warm, cosy moment on a chilly day. Crafted with all-natural ingredients and sweetened with jaggery, this rich and creamy hot chocolate offers a guilt-free indulgence that's as delicious as it is ethical. The velvety hot chocolate is perfectly balanced with soft, melt-in-your-mouth vegan marshmallows, creating a comforting and comforting beverage that can be enjoyed by everyone. Whether you're sipping it on a cold winter evening or sharing it with loved ones, this hot chocolate mix delivers the ideal blend of sweetness and warmth, making it a delightful addition to your pantry. With convenient sachet packaging and no artificial additives, this vegan-friendly treat is easy to prepare and the perfect way to brighten up your day.
details.ingredients: Hot Chocolate Mix: Skimmed Milk Powder, Jaggery, Cocoa Powder Made With The Select Aisle'S Dutch Processed Cocoa Powder, Marshmallows: Granulated Sugar, Corn Flour, Liquid Glucose, Carrageenan, Soy Protein And Natural Rock Salt
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry, hygienic place, away from direct sunlight
